Name: HIT_EFFECT_SFX_PARAM_ST
Description: Hit-spark SFX sets. HitEffectSfxConceptParam picks the row (its cell plus the attack's Hit SFX Direction 0–4, when that row exists). The attack's Hit Effect Type picks the group (Slash, Strike, Thrust, Neutral) and its Hit SFX Strength the column (0 Normal, 1 Small, 2 Large, 3 Special 1, 4 Special 2); other values play nothing. Each value is an SFX ID, spawned at the hit with the target's SFX material variation.

Fields.Description: SFX ID for a Slash hit with Hit SFX Strength 0.
